title: GAX-P05 - Native information sufficiency and selective abstention
outcome: Separate action preference from permission to act by implementing deterministic confidence controls, a dedicated learned information-sufficiency signal, calibration-split coverage policies, matched-coverage selective evaluation, explicit unsafe-commit/over-abstention accounting, and a reproducible keep/reject/defer ledger.
rationale: P04 qualified the ECAL mechanism framework but does not solve overcommitment. P05 therefore treats abstention as a policy over model-visible information rather than another action option. The learned sufficiency mechanism is deliberately low complexity and must beat strong confidence-only controls on licensed leakage-audited development evidence before it can become a positive paper contribution.
scope_in: Dedicated learned information-sufficiency model with model-visible-only features
Calibration-split threshold selection for declared target coverage
Matched-coverage AURC and risk-at-coverage evaluation through canonical GAXBench functions
Probability calibration metrics for learned sufficiency where applicable
Deterministic run manifest binding git SHA, compute provenance, data hashes, checkpoint identity, selector configuration, and coverage target
scope_out: No real patient data or PHI
No autonomous diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, triage, or emergency-use claim
No formal conformal guarantee unless later theorem assumptions are implemented and verified
No learned-sufficiency superiority claim from synthetic fixtures
No FHIR retrieval or clarification policy
acceptance: Max probability, normalized entropy confidence, and top-1/top-2 margin selectors have frozen deterministic definitions and unit tests
Learned information sufficiency is a separate probability-like signal and is not derived by relabeling the action top-1 probability
Learned sufficiency inference can consume only model-visible state/candidate information and action-distribution summaries

Changing only gold action, gold sufficiency, source identity, task-family bookkeeping, provenance, or evidence relation labels does not change learned sufficiency when model-visible content is unchanged
Learned sufficiency training uses train-split sufficiency labels only and does not update the frozen action model
Coverage thresholds are selected from calibration scores without final-test labels
P05 selector evaluation accepts validation evidence for mechanism qualification and rejects final-test use in the P05 keep/reject path
All selectors are compared on identical examples and declared target coverage using canonical risk-coverage functions
Unsafe-commit and over-abstention rates are reported together so a policy cannot win by refusing nearly everything
Requested, completed, and failed counts remain explicit and no example is silently dropped
Synthetic P05 fixtures contain no clinical text, PHI, real thresholds, diagnosis rules, or treatment guidance
Synthetic mechanism qualification can only yield implementation evidence; the learned mechanism paper decision remains defer-real-data until licensed leakage-audited development evidence exists
A deterministic manifest binds git SHA, compute provenance, model/checkpoint revision, train/calibration/validation hashes, sufficiency config, selectors, and target coverage
CLI commands reproduce the P05 manifest and matched selector suite from a frozen GAX v0 checkpoint
Exact-head CI passes Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
Implementation merges with an exact-head guard, post-main CI succeeds, and a separate canonical closeout is required before SG-000008 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert the P05 implementation branch and return to canonical P04 main 623602fecb803943cb877e3051eeb97d086e892c. No real clinical datasets, released weights, or production clinical behavior are affected by this grain.

minimality.rationale: The minimal falsifiable P05 mechanism is a dedicated logistic sufficiency signal over model-visible state features and action-distribution summaries, compared against strong deterministic confidence controls under the same calibration and coverage protocol.

requirements: Never expose gold.sufficient, gold action, provenance, split labels, task-family bookkeeping, or benchmark-only evidence relations to the sufficiency model at inference.
Never fit thresholds or calibration parameters on final-test labels.
Never call abstention itself clinical safety.
Always report both unsafe commits and over-abstention.
Never promote synthetic selective results into a paper superiority claim.

unresolved_decisions: Learned sufficiency paper status remains defer-real-data until licensed development evidence exists.
No formal conformal guarantee is claimed in P05.
Evidence retrieval/clarification behavior remains P06/P07 work.
Final clinical backbone remains unresolved until P08 qualification.
